result.summary: The street environment is characterized by a lack of dedicated pedestrian infrastructure, featuring narrow, discontinuous sidewalks and no marked crossings. A high retaining wall on one side and parked vehicles on the other create a constrained corridor with limited visibility and no physical separation between pedestrians and motor traffic.

hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs, requiring pedestrians to cross an unmarked two-way street.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a continuous sidewalk separated from the roadway by a narrow grass buffer, but it is severely constrained by a tall, blank sound wall. This configuration creates a corridor effect with no natural surveillance or active frontage, which can impact the perceived and actual safety of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The tall sound wall creates a long stretch of walkway with no 'eyes on the street', reducing natural surveillance and personal safety.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire background of the sidewalk

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
hazards.description: While a high-mast light is visible, there is no lighting specifically oriented toward the sidewalk, which may create dark spots at night.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting fixtures at a lower height along the sidewalk to improve visibility and security for people walking at night.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting trees in the grass buffer would provide shade and a more substantial physical barrier between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Wall Treatments
interventions.description: Incorporate murals or vertical greenery on the sound wall to improve the visual environment and reduce the sense of isolation.
